ebay._comment: category_id 212 is eBay's 'Sports Trading Cards' category as of 2026. eBay occasionally renumbers categories -- if active-listing results look wrong, look up the current ID via the Taxonomy API (GET /commerce/taxonomy/v1/category_tree/0) and update this value.

craigslist._headless_comment: Craigslist blocks plain HTTP requests, so this drives a real (headless) Chromium instance instead. If headless still gets blocked, flip this to false -- it'll pop a visible browser window instead, which only works when run while logged into the Mac's desktop (not from cron unattended).
